title: eludite.debug.toggle_breakpoint input
description: Debug > Toggle Breakpoint (F9, or a click in the editor's breakpoint margin), and the Breakpoints window's edits: set, change or delete the breakpoint on a line. Breakpoints persist per solution and apply to a running session at once. Conditions are C# expressions evaluated by the debugger; a hit condition breaks only on some hits.

path.description: The source file (absolute or relative to the solution folder). Default: the active document.

line.description: 1-based line. Default: the caret's line in the active document.

action.description: `toggle` (default): add a breakpoint, or delete the one on the line. `set`: add or change it with the fields given. `delete`: delete it. `delete_all`: delete every breakpoint (path and line are ignored).

enabled.description: With `set`: enable or disable the breakpoint (it stays in the Breakpoints window).

condition.description: With `set`: break only when this expression is true. An empty string removes the condition.

hit_condition.description: With `set`: break only when the hit count is `N` (equal to N), `>=N` (at least N) or `%N` (a multiple of N), as Visual Studio's Hit Count. An empty string removes it.
